notes: Cash basis (modified cash) school district; school nutrition is reported within Other Governmental Funds so treated as governmental; no separate business-type funds. Receipts/disbursements from Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds (p5), Total Governmental Funds column. Combined Taxes line (2,794,431) split using Statement of Activities general receipts (p2), which sum exactly to it; Intermediate sources 22,806 split from general fund schedule p8 (22,606 + 200). State sources 3,640,905 split using the fund schedules: nameplate capacity tax 13,611 (other taxes) and the rest state aid 3,627,294 (the fund-schedule lines add to 3,627,295; $1 rounding absorbed in the state aid item). Beginning/ending cash are governmental fund balances (cash basis); net position statement p1 used for balance sheet (no liabilities). Hidden transfers: the printed net Transfers In (Out) is 222,500 (p5) but gross transfers received are 300,469 (Depreciation 200,000, Employee Benefit 12,500, Activities 17,969, School Nutrition 60,000, Cooperative 10,000) against a General Fund transfer out of only 77,969 (Activities + School Nutrition). General Fund lines 2900 Other Support Services 12,500 (p10) and 2190 Student - Other 10,000 (p9) match the Employee Benefit and Cooperative transfers exactly and are treated as transfers out (split out of the statement-level Student Transportation and Support Services: Students lines, both marked computed). No spending line equals the 200,000 Depreciation transfer, and the General Fund components statement (p6) shows no 200,000 outflow in its transfers or fund balance; it is left one-sided as printed (report_discrepancies). Top level records transfers_in 300,469 (gross) and transfers_out 100,469 (77,969 + 12,500 + 10,000); identity: 5,729,175 + 7,428,912 (lines) - 6,790,641 (lines after splits) + 300,469 - 100,469 = 6,567,446 (printed receipts total is 7,428,913; $1 rounding). In detail, the 2900 and 2190 lines are recorded as other financing (-12,500, -10,000); the General Fund detail_totals are unchanged and still tie. Detail: General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (pp8-11) used for General Fund (the more detailed than the combining statement); other funds' budget-and-actual schedules pp12-20 (Student Fee Fund is inside Student Activities in the statements; it is not a column in the p7 combining statement). The General Fund schedule's Total Disbursements 5,997,944 includes the 77,969 transfer (recorded as other financing); combining statement p6 shows 5,919,975 disbursements. Schedule to Accounts with County Treasurers (p21) is a pass-through of General Fund tax collections and was not recorded to avoid double counting. Rounding differences of $1-2 exist in the printed report (see report_discrepancies). Read pages 1-21 of 21. Non-revenue receipts 62,748 split: General Fund 7,656 proceeds from disposal (sale of assets) and the remaining 55,092 in other.
